description: An ephemeral WebRTC signaling message exchanged between participants of an in-platform voice space to establish the peer mesh and coordinate stage changes.

main.description: A WebRTC signaling message for an in-platform voice space.

spaceId.description: Local id of the VoiceSpace this signal belongs to

fromParticipantId.description: Local id of the sending participant

fromDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the sender

signalType.description: offer/answer = RTCSessionDescription; candidate = RTCIceCandidate; leave = peer disconnecting
